title: Irregular Drinking Water Supply in Rural Communities
description:
Residents of several rural areas face irregular and unreliable drinking water supply. Some villages receive water only once every few days, while others depend on distant hand pumps or tankers. During summer, the problem becomes more severe due to falling groundwater levels and increased demand.

Citizens currently have no centralized way to report water-supply issues, track complaints, or identify areas requiring urgent intervention. A technology-based solution could help map affected locations, monitor water availability, identify recurring problems, and coordinate solutions with local communities.

solution.title: JalWatch — IoT Water Monitoring Network
solution.description: Deploy low-cost water-level sensors in community tanks and connect them to a cloud dashboard. The system will detect abnormal drops in water levels, identify pump failures, and automatically alert the responsible team.

collaborationProposals.idea: We propose integrating solar-powered IoT sensors with the JalWatch platform. Our team can provide sensor hardware, cloud integration expertise, and technical mentorship for the pilot deployment.

completionSubmission.summary: JalWatch pilot successfully deployed across 5 village water tanks. Sensors are transmitting water-level data to the dashboard and automated low-level alerts are operational.
